specs-o.esr_esl_dc_bias_source-s: Würth Elektronik LTspice model library WCAP-ATLI.lib (rev22a, 6/1/2022, eiSos EDA Service; github.com/WurthElektronik/LTspice-Library sub/WCAP-ATLI.lib, the repository Würth's LTspice user guide UG002 names), subckt 860080274011_470uF: Rser 0.062 ohm, Lser 4 nH, C 470 µF, Rpar 212766 ohm -> esr_mohm = Rser (frequency-independent model, so also the ESR at SRF), esl_ph = Lser, srf_mhz = 1/(2 pi sqrt(Lser C)). Model values, not a measured curve; temperature not stated. Würth datasheet 860080274011 rev 1.0 (2014-11-11): impedance 0.075 ohm max (100 kHz, 20 degC), 0.221 ohm max (100 kHz, -10 degC); ripple 750 mA max (100 kHz, 105 degC); DF 14 % typ (120 Hz); leakage 47 µA max; load life 3000 h at 105 degC. DC bias not applicable (electrolytic). Read 2026-10-27

component-o.description-s: 470 µF ±20% 10 V aluminum electrolytic capacitor, WCAP-ATLI (low impedance, 105 °C 3000 h), radial can 8.0 x 11.5 mm, 3.5 mm lead pitch, 0.5 mm leads
